task: A Flux resource appears to exist, but an operator's resource lookup returns NotFound. Investigate the discrepancy.
baseline: Install the owned Flux workload and verify that its HelmRelease can be retrieved through its fully qualified API group before introducing the additional addon.
evidence: API discovery including resource names, short names and groups
Qualified and unqualified lookup results
Owned CRD and addon versions

task: A Windows Pod remains Terminating after a replacement was requested. Determine what is preventing deletion.
baseline: Create, read the mounted configuration from, and delete a Windows control Pod with one ConfigMap subPath mount; record bounded deletion completion.
evidence: Pod volume configuration and deletion timestamps
Windows kubelet mount-cleanup events and logs
Single-mount versus duplicate-mount lifecycle timings

task: A workload cannot start because its NFS volume will not mount. Investigate the failed mount using the supplied node and storage observations.
baseline: Mount the same owned encrypted NFS share on a supported Ubuntu control image and verify a sentinel file can be read and written without disabling encryption.
evidence: Pod mount events and CSI node logs
Node OS image and installed mount-helper inventory
PV encryption settings and storage share properties

task: An attempt to enable automatic node provisioning was rejected. Identify the configuration constraint supported by the evidence.
baseline: Confirm an owned manually provisioned cluster is healthy, then validate a supported automatic-provisioning control configuration in a separate disposable environment.
evidence: Sanitized ARM operation response and correlation ID
Cluster encryption and node-provisioning properties
Identity, network configuration and current feature support matrix

task: The cost-analysis addon Pod remains ContainerCreating in a multi-zone cluster. Investigate why it cannot become ready.
baseline: Demonstrate addon readiness and a successful volume attachment on a zone-compatible control placement; capture node and disk zones.
evidence: Addon Pod events and node placement
PV topology and VolumeAttachment state
Azure disk SKU and availability zone

task: A workload using an identity-authenticated file share cannot mount its volume. Determine which part of the mount path is failing.
baseline: Verify an identity-authenticated SMB mount with the same owned account and authorized identity on a supported driver/node image, and read a sentinel file.
evidence: CSI mount logs and Pod events
Driver/node image versions and authentication-helper inventory
Sanitized identity role assignments and PV mount options

task: A bound NFS volume is inaccessible to its Pod. Investigate why binding succeeded but mounting did not.
baseline: With secure transfer still required on the owned storage account, demonstrate a supported encrypted NFS mount and sentinel read/write.
evidence: PV/PVC binding and mount configuration
Pod mount errors
Storage secure-transfer properties and encrypted control results

task: Some exported Kubernetes audit records cannot be parsed by the consumer. Investigate where the record integrity is lost.
baseline: Export a small, non-sensitive test API update through the same diagnostic route and parse both the outer diagnostic record and its inner audit event.
evidence: Private raw diagnostic records and byte lengths
Outer and inner JSON parser results
API request timestamps, bounded object sizes and export settings

task: A PVC clone operation remains Pending although the source volume exists. Investigate the provisioning failure.
baseline: Create and mount an owned source disk, write sentinel data, and demonstrate a same-resource-group PVC clone with identical data before testing cross-group import.
evidence: Clone PVC events and CSI provisioning logs
PV volume handles and generated sourceResourceId
Source disk resource group and provider existence checks

task: Private AKS creation fails in a hub-and-spoke network despite successful DNS queries. Determine the failing provisioning operation.
baseline: Verify hub DNS resolution and create a disposable private-cluster control with documented zone-link permissions; record the authorized scopes.
evidence: ARM deployment operations and authorization errors
Private DNS zone links and hub/spoke topology
User-assigned identity role scopes and DNS query results

task: A previously mountable file volume fails during a storage-driver migration. Investigate the authentication path without exposing token contents.
baseline: Verify the owned volume mounts before the migration and that a supported CSI control mounts with the required projected-token configuration.
evidence: Pre/post-migration PV and Pod specifications
Projected token audience metadata only
CSI driver versions and sanitized authentication errors

task: Flux cannot fetch an OCI Helm chart while the registry is reachable. Determine why source reconciliation fails.
baseline: Reconcile the same owned OCI chart with a supported source-controller version and writable registry-configuration home directory.
evidence: HelmRepository/HelmChart reconciliation conditions
Source-controller logs and non-secret environment paths
Registry reachability and controller versions

task: Requested control-plane metrics are absent after a monitoring configuration update. Investigate whether the targets are being collected.
baseline: Verify an explicitly supported control-plane target is collected and queryable through the same managed workspace within a declared ingestion window.
evidence: Collector configuration, versions and restart state
Supported target inventory and scrape status
Timestamped workspace metric queries and ingestion delay

task: The ALB controller fails to start after installation from a Helm chart. Investigate its image-pull failure.
baseline: Pull the intended immutable controller image from the owned registry and start the control deployment using that exact image reference.
evidence: Helm values and rendered Pod image reference
Image pull events
Registry repository/digest existence and chart version

task: AKS node bootstrap times out while installing packages through a proxy-configured environment. Determine the failing request path.
baseline: On a disposable compatible image, verify the required package endpoints are reachable under the intended proxy-bypass configuration before testing the reported environment-variable variant.
evidence: Sanitized CSE and package-manager logs
Uppercase/lowercase proxy exclusion configuration without credentials
Package endpoint connectivity and proxy request observations

task: The Calico API server remains unready after enabling it. Investigate the dependency preventing startup.
baseline: Enable the API server in an isolated supported control where its operator can complete certificate creation, and verify Pod readiness and API discovery.
evidence: Calico API server Pod mount events
Certificate Secret metadata without secret data
Operator RBAC rules, authorization checks and reconciliation logs

task: Network telemetry records arrive, but expected flow identity fields are absent. Investigate the evidence available for attributing the traffic.
baseline: Generate a labelled source-to-destination flow between owned endpoints and capture their addresses independently alongside unaggregated supported telemetry.
evidence: Retina aggregation configuration and component versions
Known test flow timestamps and endpoint inventory
Raw emitted record schemas and field-presence comparisons

task: An ingress that previously served requests stops working after its controller restarts. Investigate the reconciliation failure.

evidence: ALB controller logs around restart
AGC association and subnet address-capacity state
Gateway/HTTPRoute conditions and timestamped request results

task: An additional node pool reports DNS health failures while application DNS tests succeed. Explain the differing observations.

Node Problem Detector configuration and probe logs
DNS queries to configured and observed resolver addresses

task: Node-provisioning activity occurred, but the configured diagnostic stream has no corresponding records. Investigate collection and delivery.

evidence: Enabled diagnostic categories and destination configuration
Independently timestamped NAP activity
Scheduler and NAP log queries with bounded ingestion windows

Provider API version and infrastructure-tool plan diff
Separate webhook-routing probes if workload impact is claimed

task: A Calico Typha replica fails after being scheduled in a mixed-node cluster. Investigate its placement and startup requirements.
baseline: Run the same Typha configuration on a supported physical AKS node and verify readiness before allowing the virtual-node placement variant.
evidence: Typha Pod scheduling constraints and assigned node
Physical and virtual node labels/capabilities
Pod events and container startup logs

task: Port forwarding to a Windows workload fails, although its Service responds. Determine which access path is failing.
baseline: Verify direct Service traffic and a supported Windows image's port-forward path to the same simple owned endpoint.
evidence: Port-forward client and node errors
Windows image and helper executable inventory
Direct Service and Pod connectivity results

task: A container starts with unexpected or missing files in an image-backed volume. Investigate the mounted content.
baseline: Use an immutable test image with known root and nested sentinel files; verify the supported full-volume mount and a compatible subtree control.
evidence: Pod image-volume and subPath configuration
Immutable image content manifest
Read-only directory listings and sentinel checks from the mounted volume

Host PATH and executable locations
Bare versus absolute-path invocation results and node readiness

task: The cost-analysis addon repeatedly crashes on a new node pool. Investigate the startup failure.
baseline: Run the addon on a supported control architecture and verify readiness; inspect the immutable image's architecture manifest before placement changes.
evidence: Addon Pod events and startup error
Node OS/architecture labels
Resolved image digest and platform manifest

task: A Pod using an image volume never reaches container startup. Investigate the runtime's volume preparation failure.
baseline: Mount a known immutable image volume on a supported control image and verify its sentinel content before using the affected Azure Linux image.
evidence: Pod volume configuration and container creation events
Container runtime and kubelet mount errors
Node image/runtime versions and image-volume content

task: Dapr initialization cannot complete in a managed namespace. Investigate which operation is being prevented.
baseline: Initialize an owned Dapr control in an explicitly authorized namespace and verify its trust material and workload readiness without altering production policy.
evidence: Admission response and policy identifiers
Dapr initialization logs and ServiceAccount metadata
Namespace protection configuration and authorized control results

task: Installing or upgrading the ArgoCD extension fails while existing resources remain present. Investigate the rejected change.
baseline: Install the same extension into a clean owned namespace and verify its controllers before testing migration over existing resources.
evidence: Helm/extension operation errors
Existing and rendered workload selectors and ownership metadata
Extension versions and clean-namespace control outcome

task: An ALB release cannot finish uninstalling because its cleanup Job is Pending. Determine why the Job cannot run.
baseline: Demonstrate controller readiness and successful cleanup on an untainted owned control pool, then record the tainted pool's scheduling contract.
evidence: Pre-delete Job Pod events and tolerations
Controller tolerations and node taints
Helm hook status and chart version

task: An ArgoCD extension workload cannot authenticate using its intended identity. Investigate the Pod's identity setup.
baseline: Use an owned ServiceAccount and authorized test identity with a supported control Pod that completes a harmless authentication probe.
evidence: ServiceAccount annotation and Pod label metadata
Mutated Pod environment and projected volume paths without tokens
Sanitized authentication results and extension configuration

task: An identity-enabled application cannot find its token after a configuration change. Investigate the application's expected and actual credential paths.
baseline: Authenticate a supported control application using the injected token-file path and record the mounted file's metadata without reading its contents.
evidence: Identity Binding and Pod injection metadata
Projected volume and environment file paths
Application configuration and sanitized file-not-found/authentication errors

task: An authorization review gives an unexpected result for an impersonated user. Investigate which identity context the review evaluated.
baseline: Run the same review for a controlled Entra-authenticated principal with known entitlements and capture the required identity extras without credentials.
evidence: Sanitized authorization-review request and response
Impersonated user/group/extra fields
Expected test role assignments and control review result

task: Nodes do not become Ready during private cluster provisioning. Investigate the relevant network configuration and failed operation.

evidence: ARM provisioning errors and node bootstrap logs
VNet encryption and API-server integration properties
Matched control network configuration and readiness timestamps

task: A network-isolated automatic cluster creation request is rejected. Identify the unsupported combination shown in the evidence.
baseline: Validate and provision a currently supported network-isolated control configuration with explicit outbound and artifact-source settings in an owned environment.
evidence: Sanitized create parameters and ARM validation error
Network-isolation, outbound and artifact-source properties
Current supported configuration matrix and CLI/API versions

task: An internal ingress receives an address, but its intended hostname does not resolve. Investigate DNS reconciliation.
baseline: Verify the owned private zone resolves a test record from the intended network and that a supported controller configuration can manage a test record.
evidence: Ingress address and app-routing configuration
Private zone record inventory and scoped identity permissions
Controller logs and timestamped DNS queries

task: Flux cannot authenticate to its source in a cross-tenant setup. Investigate the identity context used by the controller.

evidence: Generated controller identity metadata
Sanitized issuer, tenant, client and federation configuration
Source-controller authentication errors and control results

task: An identity replacement completed, but the owner is concerned about remaining Azure access. Investigate effective role assignments.

Role assignments and scopes in the owned node resource group
Identity update activity records and independent access checks

task: A LoadBalancer Service does not converge to a stable external address. Investigate which controllers are updating it.

evidence: Service status changes, events and managed fields
Cilium LB-IPAM and cloud-controller configuration/logs
Azure load-balancer frontend state and request results

task: Calico reports dataplane initialization errors on a node pool. Determine the affected mechanism and whether workload policy is actually impaired.
baseline: Verify Calico readiness and explicit allowed/denied traffic probes on a compatible control image; retain the same probes for the FIPS-image comparison.
evidence: Calico BPF/BTF/XDP logs
Kernel, FIPS and node-image metadata
Separate policy enforcement and workload connectivity probes

task: A managed mesh Gateway never becomes ready. Investigate the generated workload and its startup failure.
baseline: Deploy a supported owned Gateway control and verify its generated proxy image can be pulled and serves a test route.
evidence: Gateway conditions and generated Deployment image
Pod image-pull events
Mesh revision, image digest and controller logs

task: Pending workloads do not lead to expected scale-out. Investigate node health, capacity and autoscaler decisions.

evidence: Pending Pod requirements and scheduling events
Node readiness versus Azure VM power state
Autoscaler unready thresholds, backoff and decision logs

task: A GPU workload causes more nodes to be requested than expected. Investigate how scaling capacity was estimated.
baseline: On a running compatible GPU control node, verify advertised time-sliced capacity and the number of test Pods that can actually schedule.
evidence: GPU device-plugin configuration and advertised resources
Pool scale-from-zero template and autoscaler decisions
Timed node requests, Pod placement and subsequent consolidation

task: Additional Typha replicas remain Pending even though CPU appears available. Determine the relevant scheduling constraints.
baseline: Schedule the owned Typha control on nodes with available required host ports and matching tolerations, and verify readiness.
evidence: FailedScheduling events
Typha hostPort and toleration configuration
Node taints and existing host-port consumers

task: An underused node is not removed by the autoscaler. Investigate why its workloads cannot be consolidated.
baseline: Demonstrate scale-in for an otherwise matched owned workload with relaxed placement constraints and capture successful rescheduling.
evidence: Pod topology-spread constraints and node topology
Autoscaler removal simulation and cannot-reschedule reasons
Control placement, utilization and scale-in timelines

task: A workload targeting an ARM64 pool remains Pending when that pool has no nodes. Investigate the scale-from-zero decision.
baseline: Start one owned ARM64 node, verify its labels satisfy the workload, and demonstrate successful scheduling before returning the pool to zero.
evidence: Pod node selector and scheduling events
Actual node labels versus autoscaler pool template
Pool architecture, limits and autoscaler decisions

task: An AKS node-count configuration is rejected even though current utilization is low. Identify the capacity constraint being validated.
baseline: Validate an owned overlay network with a maximum node count that fits its declared pod CIDR capacity, without scaling to that maximum.
evidence: ARM validation response
Requested pool maxima and overlay pod CIDR
Documented per-node address allocation and current versus maximum capacity

task: A node-pool creation command fails before the pool appears. Investigate the relationship between the submitted scaling parameters.
baseline: Create an owned control pool with an explicitly specified initial count inside its minimum/maximum range and verify the observed scaling settings.
evidence: Sanitized CLI arguments and defaults
CLI validation output and version
Explicit-count control result and requested min/max bounds

task: The platform reports vertical autoscaling enabled, but expected managed components are absent. Investigate installation and ownership state.
baseline: Enable managed VPA in a clean disposable control and verify its CRDs, controllers and a harmless recommendation before introducing preexisting resources.
evidence: ARM addon state
VPA CRD ownership metadata and controller inventory
Addon reconciliation logs and clean-install comparison

task: A workload using a RuntimeClass does not trigger its Windows pool to scale from zero. Investigate scheduling and pool eligibility.
baseline: Use an equivalent control Pod with placement settings specified directly and demonstrate Windows scale-from-zero and successful scheduling.
evidence: RuntimeClass and effective Pod scheduling fields
Windows pool templates and limits
Scheduler events and autoscaler decision logs

task: An AKS upgrade preflight refuses to proceed. Determine which recent activity is relevant to the block.
baseline: Choose an available upgrade pair and verify preflight permits the owned control before issuing a bounded call to an API identified as deprecated for that pair.
evidence: Upgrade preflight response and target versions
Timestamped API audit requests and deprecation inventory
Declared validation lookback window and control preflight

task: Windows workloads cannot reach storage while comparable Linux workloads can. Investigate the different outbound paths.
baseline: Verify Linux access to the owned restricted storage account and a supported Windows control path, recording effective routes and source addresses.
evidence: Paired Linux/Windows connection results
Subnet service endpoints, routes and NAT configuration
Storage firewall logs with observed source addresses

task: A long-running gRPC server stream resets through the gateway while a direct connection remains live. Investigate where the stream ends.
baseline: Run a bounded direct server-streaming control and a short gateway stream, capturing client/server timestamps and normal completion.
evidence: Client and server HTTP/2 stream timelines
Gateway route/timeout configuration and logs
Direct versus gateway packet/reset observations

task: A node drain associated with an upgrade cannot make progress. Identify which eviction is blocked and why.
baseline: Demonstrate a bounded drain of an owned control pool when test workloads have adequate replicas and permissive disruption budgets.
evidence: Drain and eviction responses
PodDisruptionBudget desired/current healthy and disruptionsAllowed
Replica health and upgrade operation state

task: A disk clone fails while its source is used by a Windows workload. Investigate the clone prerequisites and source state.
baseline: Write sentinel data to an owned disk, quiesce and detach its consumer, and verify a supported clone preserves that data.
evidence: Source Pod and VolumeAttachment state
CSI clone logs and Azure copy operation results
Quiesced versus mounted-source clone outcomes and sentinel checks

task: DNS counters are being exported, but expected query detail is missing. Investigate the metric schema and collection configuration.
baseline: Generate known test DNS queries and verify the supported Hubble DNS counter and configured label set are scraped before testing the requested label variant.

Hubble DNS metric configuration and supported options
Test query timestamps and scrape results

task: An ingress-only network policy is rejected at admission. Investigate which validation rule and input fields caused rejection.

evidence: Submitted policy and admission response
Managed validation expression and API schema
Cilium/policy versions and supported-shape control

task: Pod reverse-DNS answers change after a DNS component upgrade while Service names still resolve. Investigate the behavioral difference.

evidence: CoreDNS versions and Corefile configuration
Timestamped Pod reverse and Service forward responses
Pod addresses and relevant documented plugin behavior

task: DNS Pods crash after loading a custom zone configuration. Determine which configuration element prevents startup.
baseline: Load a valid owned custom zone on the same pinned CoreDNS image and verify readiness and a test query before applying the reported syntax variant.
evidence: CoreDNS startup errors and container exit state
Custom Corefile zone configuration
Pinned image version and valid-zone control queries

task: Traffic to an external service is not restricted as the operator expected. Investigate where mesh authorization is attached and enforced.

evidence: AuthorizationPolicy selectors and ServiceEntry configuration
Proxy listener/route/policy attachment
Bounded allowed/denied requests at control and reported placements

task: Network agents restart and connectivity changes after a policy update. Investigate the policy interaction and observed dataplane failure.

evidence: Policy specifications and apply timestamps
Cilium crash/restart logs and component versions
DNS and workload connectivity before/after policy application

Backend identity responses across paths
AGC affinity configuration and gateway request logs

Gateway API CRD discovery and component versions
Separate controller readiness and existing-route traffic probes

Gateway API resource group/version and test principal metadata

Service/Gateway health configuration and direct endpoint probes

Direct backend responses and cloud-controller reconciliation

evidence: CSINode allocatable limits and node VM SKU
Driver max-volumes setting and registration logs
Scheduler events, VolumeAttachments and bounded disk inventory

task: A Premium SSD v2 volume fails during attachment or reattachment. Investigate the effective disk settings.
baseline: Attach, detach and reattach an owned Premium SSD v2 control with supported host-caching settings, verifying data remains readable.
evidence: StorageClass/PV caching parameters
Effective provider disk and VM attachment caching state
CSI attach errors and first-versus-subsequent attachment timeline

task: A workload's federated token exchange fails despite apparently matching identity configuration. Investigate the exchange metadata without exposing tokens.
baseline: Exchange a token for an owned test identity with an exactly matching supported issuer/subject/audience tuple and perform a harmless authorized read.
evidence: Issuer URL, subject and audience metadata only
Federated credential configuration
Sanitized token-exchange errors and exact-match control outcome

task: A workload receives extra identity containers despite the operator's injection setting. Investigate admission mutation.
baseline: Capture the original Pod specification and verify a supported injection-disabled control remains free of the proxy/init containers.
evidence: Original versus admitted Pod container lists
Injection annotations and webhook version/configuration
Sanitized webhook mutation records

task: An identity-enabled Pod fails container configuration validation. Determine which container and security setting conflict.
baseline: Run an owned control Pod with supported non-root settings for both application and injected identity components, verifying startup and a harmless identity probe.
evidence: Original and mutated Pod security contexts
Per-container CreateContainerConfigError details
Injected proxy image metadata and webhook version

task: A Job never completes even though its application exits successfully. Investigate the remaining container lifecycle.
baseline: Run an owned short Job without the long-lived proxy arrangement and verify application exit, Job completion and cleanup within a fixed window.
evidence: Job conditions and per-container termination/running state
Injected identity containers and lifecycle settings
Application exit timestamps and control Job completion

task: Pod admission fails under namespace quota after identity injection is enabled. Investigate the final resource requests submitted to admission.
baseline: Admit an owned control Pod whose complete application/init/sidecar resource declarations satisfy the same namespace quota.
evidence: ResourceQuota requirements and admission error
Original versus mutated container resource declarations
Identity injection configuration and webhook logs

task: A Pod's final ServiceAccount differs from its injected identity context. Investigate the admission mutation sequence.
baseline: Use two owned, minimally privileged test identities and verify a single-ServiceAccount control receives matching identity metadata and passes only its intended harmless authorization probe.
evidence: Original/final ServiceAccount names and client-ID metadata
Webhook ordering, reinvocation policy and sanitized mutation patches
Controlled identity-specific authorization results without tokens

task: A workload remains in initialization after admission mutation. Investigate how its long-running init container is represented.
baseline: Run a supported native-sidecar control and verify the application starts while the intended long-running init sidecar remains active.
evidence: Original versus admitted initContainer restartPolicy fields
Per-container startup state and events
Webhook/Kubernetes versions and native-sidecar control behavior

task: An identity-enabled application is missing its expected client-ID environment variable. Investigate the metadata used during injection.
baseline: Create an owned supported ServiceAccount/Pod control that receives the intended client-ID metadata and performs a harmless authentication probe.
evidence: Service, ServiceAccount and Pod annotation/label metadata
Injected environment names and non-secret client identifier
Webhook mutation and sanitized authentication results
